## Summary

Describe the functional purpose and user or business outcome.

## Scope

List what is included and any important exclusions.

## Architecture and implementation

Describe affected components, contracts, data, modular boundaries, and compatibility.

## Security

Describe authentication, authorization, IAM, input validation, secrets, and risks.

## QA and validation

List only commands and checks that were actually executed, with their real results.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Identify each applicable criterion and its status.

## DevOps and deployment

Describe configuration, infrastructure, migration, rollout, monitoring, and cost impact.

## Risks and rollback

Describe known risks and a concrete recovery procedure.

## Assumptions and limitations

Record deferred work, assumptions, and remaining limitations.
